name: Anti-Looser
source:
Komori Niito is a single 30-something freeware developer who has yet to finish a single one of her projects. She aims to finally release one of said projects into the world and escape her unproductive lifestyle, but at the same time, she's stuck putting up with constant mistreatment at the hands of the ill-natured tomgirl Shizukuishi Mouke. 

But how exactly will Niito's story end...?
translation:
故森ニィト是一名三十多岁的单身女性，制作免费游戏至今，却连一部作品都没能完成。她想终于将其中一个项目发布出去，摆脱毫无成果的生活，却同时不得不忍受性格恶劣的女装少年雫石モウケ不断欺凌辱骂。

ニィト的故事，究竟会以怎样的结局收场……？
